expectations.text: Plan has explicit Scope IN and Scope OUT lists
Implementer steps include rationale where needed
Plan has Checkpoint or verification markers per step
Plan does NOT include a Meta / prompt-template section
Plan uses sub-lists for multi-part thoughts (>= 5 nested bullets)
No multi-sentence prose paragraphs longer than 200 chars
Plan does NOT include 'Why not [alternative]' subsection
Plan does NOT include 'Why this matters for the goal' filler tags
Implementer section contains at least one inline code block
